name: Approval Timed Out
description: Sent to the approval requester and approvers when no resolution has been reached for an approval request since instantiation based on an admin-configured number of days.
subject: An approval request has timed out
body:
Approval request timed out

Hello ${__recipient.name},

An approval request for $approvalName that was submitted #if($requestee.name && $requestee.name != '' && $requestee.identityID == $__recipient.id) on your behalf by $requester.name #elseif($requestee.name && $requestee.name != '') by $requestee.name #elseif($requester.identityID == $__recipient.id) by you #else by $requester.name #end has timed out. No resolution was reached within $timeoutDays days, and the request is now closed.

This approval request is closed — timed out with no resolution.

#if($requestee.identityID == $__recipient.id || $requester.identityID == $__recipient.id)

To review your approval requests or to create a new one, use the link below.

Review approval requests
#else

To review approval requests that are assigned to you, use the link below.

Review approval requests
#end

Thank you,
The ${__global.productName} Team
